description: When issuer.subject != cert.issuer (line 102) or anchor.subject != cert.issuer (line 228), returns Err(OcspSignatureInvalid) though no signature was attempted. Misleads callers into looking for algorithm/key mismatch. Fix: return Err(Error::OcspCertIdMismatch) or add OcspIssuerMismatch variant. File: pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs lines 102, 228.
title: ocsp: issuer DN mismatch returns OcspSignatureInvalid
